profiles.name: Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar
profiles.position: Menteri Besar of Terengganu; Chairman of Perikatan Nasional; Member of the Dewan Rakyat
profiles.description: Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar represents Kemaman, Terengganu, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Menteri Besar of Terengganu; Chairman of Perikatan Nasional; Member of the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

profiles.name: Siti Mastura Muhammad
profiles.description: Siti Mastura Muhammad represents Kepala Batas, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

profiles.name: Wan Saiful Wan Jan
profiles.description: Wan Saiful Wan Jan represents Tasek Gelugor, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. A Parti Wawasan Negara member.

milestones.title: Target nine million visitor arrivals in Terengganu during 2026
milestones.description: The target was announced by Razali Idris while representing Menteri Besar Ahmad Samsuri at the state tourism awards.
milestones.progress_note: This is a shared state-government target, not solely the MP’s achievement. The cited 8.512 million arrivals concern 2025 and cannot measure the 2026 target. A full-year 2026 result was not verified.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
